// Generated by generate.py from the frozen binary level control.
/// Same while guard, row call, chronological writes and n=w as the generated
/// binary_level. source_row contains that exact row body and has a verified
/// full-state contract; no arbitrary-coordinate weakening enters the stub.
pub fn source_level_via_rows(mut s:r::Scratch,nodes:&[u8],answers:&[[u8;32];16],selected:usize,coordinate:usize)->(bool,r::Scratch,usize,u8) {
 let mut i=0;let mut w=0;let mut calls=0;let mut event=0;
 while i<s.n {
  assert!(calls<16);
  let out=source_row(s,nodes,i,w,answers[calls],coordinate);
  if calls==selected && out.calls>0 {event=out.event;}
  calls+=out.calls;s=out.state;
  if !out.success {return (false,s,calls,event);}
  i=out.i;w=out.w;
 }
 s.n=w;(true,s,calls,event)
}
